decision.comment: HH_260906 - Freeze the cost-aware selection auxiliary before new measured training, while retaining every legacy data limitation and failed seed.
decision.purpose: Compare the original full-model objective with an added expected detached composite-cost regret. This is not another acceleration ablation, frozen-head-only fit, new-data admission or learned STOP-intent experiment.
decision.formula: Original best-of-K composite regression + 0.1 hard-oracle cross entropy + lambda * mean(sum(softmax(candidate_logits) * detach(composite_cost - minimum_composite_cost))). Lambda A=0, B=0.1. The same original composite costs define regression, hard labels and regret; no ADE-only relabeling.
decision.gradient: The auxiliary has direct logit gradients only; shared encoder/context parameters can still indirectly change generated trajectories during joint optimization.
decision.architecture: Same physical.v1, six candidates, 954590 parameters, supplied acceleration, decoder constants and runtime gate v8. Fresh paired seeded initialization, no historical baseline reuse or resume.
decision.budget: Six fits of 1540 optimizer steps, batch4, train1147: 6155 sample exposures each, five complete epochs plus 105 batches of a sixth. Final checkpoint only; no best-epoch or failed-seed selection.
decision.candidate_screen: Both selected ADE and FDE must improve in all three paired seeds; selected geometry pass count must not fall and selected speed MAE must not exceed 1.05 times baseline in any pair.
decision.known_data_limits: Unchanged legacy v3 train1147/val337 includes warmup anchors and infeasible deceleration targets. All denied 2026-09-08 new C-track captures and the new substep experiments stay excluded. Prior results informed this exploratory plan.
decision.test_policy: Full-corpus contract/hash checks may read test JSON and JPEG bytes. Test data is not used for training loss, model inference, reported performance or model selection.
decision.promotion: No automatic promotion, runtime bundle allowlist modification, vehicle actuation or gate weakening. New nonzero research loss metadata remains rejected by the existing secure weight-bundle export boundary.
decision.finish_policy: Before dispatch and each stage, reserve every remaining per-stage timeout plus 300 seconds before 2026-09-09 10:00 KST. Only stop owned stage process groups. No GPU1 access, foreign-job termination, reboot or installation.
